task_watchdog.runtime: Existing Python standard library and OpenCode Node-compatible built-ins
task_watchdog.scope: Exact captured native session/directory/workspace and originating ACP process; cancellation and new human input override recovery
task_watchdog.semantics: Resume the original objective with current checkpoint context, never blindly replay writes; uncertain delivery is reconciled without resending; active work and human waits do not admit retry
task_watchdog.public_status: Metadata only; never raw prompt, copied options, runtime credential or native reasoning
task_watchdog.platform: Real ACP discovery/activation currently Windows; deterministic fixtures are portable

scaffold.output: Reviewable whole-subject proposal (never applied); constructor validation and method shapes correct; behaviour helpers TODO

frozen_acceptance.failure_detail: Failed checks include observed subject values; diagnostics list frozen failures before editable-suite errors and re-attach failing contract text/interface
frozen_acceptance.runtime: Existing Python standard library and pinned Lua 5.4 sandbox image
frozen_acceptance.identity: Owned workspace + operator-selected subject path + frozen verifier SHA-256 + executing controller revision + exact tested subject SHA-256
frozen_acceptance.completion: Overall GREEN requires both editable workspace tests and all registered frozen acceptance contracts to pass. Missing or inconsistent evidence fails closed.
frozen_acceptance.scope: Generic pure-module acceptance; no game or engine dependency, model-triggered contract registration, automatic prompt submission or new package installation

recovery_guardrails.runtime: Existing Python standard library and OpenCode Node-compatible built-ins
recovery_guardrails.activation: Register local plugin with configure_recovery_guard.py --apply; hooks load on next OpenCode startup and apply only to enabled exact native session/directory binding
recovery_guardrails.limitations: No automatic approvals, prompt submission, stopped-task resurrection, native write bypass or guarantee of semantic correctness

coding_edit_safety.targeted_edits: Unique exact old_text/new_text contexts with current full-file SHA-256; unrelated bytes preserved
coding_edit_safety.checkpoint_identity: Owned workspace + relative path + full SHA-256; short storage keys for Windows portability
coding_edit_safety.large_replacement: Truncations of files >=1024 bytes and >=30 lines to <35% bytes and <50% lines require explicit intentional whole-file rewrite acknowledgement

lua_syntax_gate.parser: luac5.4 -p in the pinned no-network Lua image; never executes
lua_syntax_gate.refuses: Proposals that break a parsing .lua file or create an unparsable one
lua_syntax_gate.unavailable: Not blocking; lua_syntax.checked=false and test preflight still applies

coding_edit_safety.scope: Reviewable proposals, pre-edit recovery and current-hash admission; no gameplay semantics or external package installation

task_trace.runtime: Python standard library + native browser WebSocket/DOM
sources: Existing OpenCode SQLite metadata in read-only mode
Existing Windows PowerShell/CIM ACP listener discovery
task_trace.identity: Exact native session + current user turn + owned workspace; optional supplied Melty task ID, never fabricated
task_trace.scope: Component/file/skill lifecycle metadata and wait clues only; no prompts, reasoning, file contents, shell commands or task control

task_trace_workbench.runtime: Python standard library + native browser SVG/DOM/WebSocket; reuses the existing local GLB viewer
task_trace_workbench.scope: Read-only graph/inspector over the existing trace. Explicit artifact registration is a separate authenticated POST that stores metadata only; bytes are served only after workspace ownership, access and SHA-256 recheck. Nothing is converted, copied or published.

optional_layers.graphify: Evaluated 2026-10-27 (graphifyy 0.9.96, Apache-2.0); not installed. See docs/GRAPHIFY_TRACE_PLAN.md.

native_progress.supplemental_transport: Read-only shared SQLite lifecycle metadata for HTTP/ACP processes
native_progress.binding: Exact native session ID + native directory + owned coding workspace UUID
native_progress.scope: Public tool/status metadata across HTTP/ACP processes, reconnect reconciliation and final workspace charts; no prompts, native control, reasoning or generated media ingestion

blender.purpose: 3D asset conversion, scene and animation automation

workspace_tracking.purpose: Persistent canonical workspace/file index with SHA-256, bounded relation graphs, diagram skill and native continuity instructions. Python standard library and browser SVG; no new package, model change or WebSocket runtime

ollama_model.purpose: Reasoning model for chat and OpenCode, chosen from GPU memory by defaults.hardware_profiles. The full smoke test expects qwen3.5:9b

playwright.purpose: Browser automation for the full smoke test

chromium.purpose: Chromium for the full smoke test's GUI and GLB checks

lua.usage: run_coding_tests profile=lua (fixed offline SMELTER MCP operation; syntax-check up to 512 Lua sources in tested mods, then run up to 64 test programs)
lua.purpose: Lua 5.4.8-r0 in the existing confined image; no host Lua installation. Source syntax errors stop behavioral tests with ERROR. Receipts include source-syntax results, host runner SHA-256, host/container source hash comparison, fresh snapshot identity and actual standard-loader import paths; older Lua evidence requires retesting. Tests must import actual modules and assert failures; syntax success does not prove behavior or game compatibility. This is not a GTA/UE4SS runtime installation; LuaJIT/5.1 use a different ABI
